title: The best if all worlds
text: There is something for virtually everyone in this lovely seaside town. There are 17 golden sands beaches to choose from and everyone has a beach bar or cafe / restaurant close by. The sea is shallow and warm, so ideal for swimming. There are hotels all along the 3km long pedestrianised beach promenade. Then there us the fascinating old town with its church and three museums.  All worth seeing and enjoying. The town itself has a plethora of shops, bars, cafe, restaurants and hotels. It's lovely to wander the maze of streets as virtually no traffic and some lovely buildings to admire. The Touris
author: Steve C
